comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
4-item Memorial Album. Except it's related to Battle Campaign and there's surprisingly little information on it from my usual JP wiki sources. Care to fill in the blanks, battle fanatics? I can at least tell you this is its reward: Cane Gun

And here's something about the four items in Japanese from a blog.

apple9999.blog.fc2.com/blog-entry-725.html

Something about a chest giving the items from Battle Campaign...? Hmm. Nope, can't quite figure it out. Sorry 'bout the lackluster info for a change. I could delete this comment if somebody wants to put in the full info here, including MA reward link. Up to you... Cheers.

comments.author: Wsp
comments.body:
It seems every month the rewards rotate from Numbers 2-5. I believe you will only get the 'MA prizes' if you score more kills in the match. I personally only received the special box once and can't score any kills at BC due to all the forged guns and plates everyone brings to the party.

Source: gvo.gamedb.info/wiki/?BattleCampaign

comments.body:
